profiles.description: Gathering Storm with every DLC or leader provider needed by the 13 retained duplicate-key groups.

probes.rationale: The conditional Khmer source and final ZYL layer must resolve to the same +1 amount.
probes.query: SELECT ModifierId, Name, Value, Type, Extra, SecondExtra FROM ModifierArguments WHERE ModifierId = 'ZYL_KHMER_HOLY_SITE_RIVER_FAITH' AND Name = 'Amount' ORDER BY ModifierId, Name

probes.rationale: The conditional Khmer source and final ZYL layer must resolve to the same adjacency description.
probes.query: SELECT ModifierId, Name, Value, Type, Extra, SecondExtra FROM ModifierArguments WHERE ModifierId = 'ZYL_KHMER_HOLY_SITE_RIVER_FAITH' AND Name = 'Description' ORDER BY ModifierId, Name

probes.rationale: The conditional Khmer source and final ZYL layer must both target Holy Sites.
probes.query: SELECT ModifierId, Name, Value, Type, Extra, SecondExtra FROM ModifierArguments WHERE ModifierId = 'ZYL_KHMER_HOLY_SITE_RIVER_FAITH' AND Name = 'DistrictType' ORDER BY ModifierId, Name

probes.rationale: The conditional Khmer source and final ZYL layer must both grant Faith.
probes.query: SELECT ModifierId, Name, Value, Type, Extra, SecondExtra FROM ModifierArguments WHERE ModifierId = 'ZYL_KHMER_HOLY_SITE_RIVER_FAITH' AND Name = 'YieldType' ORDER BY ModifierId, Name

probes.rationale: The Khmer provider and final layer must leave one river-adjacency modifier without hidden requirements.
probes.query: SELECT ModifierId, ModifierType, OwnerRequirementSetId, SubjectRequirementSetId FROM Modifiers WHERE ModifierId = 'ZYL_KHMER_HOLY_SITE_RIVER_FAITH' ORDER BY ModifierId

probes.rationale: The Gaul provider and final layer must converge on the civilization-level Mine Culture attachment.
probes.query: SELECT TraitType, ModifierId FROM TraitModifiers WHERE TraitType = 'TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_GAUL' AND ModifierId = 'GAUL_MINE_CULTURE' ORDER BY TraitType, ModifierId

probes.rationale: The Gran Colombia provider and final layer must converge on the original all-unit movement attachment.
probes.query: SELECT TraitType, ModifierId FROM TraitModifiers WHERE TraitType = 'TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_EJERCITO_PATRIOTA' AND ModifierId = 'TRAIT_EJERCITO_PATRIOTA_EXTRA_MOVEMENT' ORDER BY TraitType, ModifierId

probes.rationale: The Khmer provider and final layer must converge on the civilization-level river Faith attachment.
probes.query: SELECT TraitType, ModifierId FROM TraitModifiers WHERE TraitType = 'TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_KHMER_BARAYS' AND ModifierId = 'ZYL_KHMER_HOLY_SITE_RIVER_FAITH' ORDER BY TraitType, ModifierId

probes.rationale: Negotiators and Caesar independently provide the same near-capital distance argument.
probes.query: SELECT RequirementId, Name, Value, Type FROM RequirementArguments WHERE RequirementId = 'REQUIRES_OBJECT_1_OR_MORE_TILES_FROM_CAPITAL' AND Name = 'MinDistance' ORDER BY RequirementId, Name

probes.rationale: Caesar and Gathering Storm independently provide the same captured-city predicate.
probes.query: SELECT RequirementId, RequirementType, Inverse, Reverse, Persistent, Triggered FROM Requirements WHERE RequirementId = 'BBG_REQUIRES_CITY_IS_CAPTURED' ORDER BY RequirementId

probes.rationale: Negotiators and Caesar independently provide the same near-capital predicate.
probes.query: SELECT RequirementId, RequirementType, Inverse, Reverse, Persistent, Triggered FROM Requirements WHERE RequirementId = 'REQUIRES_OBJECT_1_OR_MORE_TILES_FROM_CAPITAL' ORDER BY RequirementId

probes.rationale: Macedon/Persia and Vikings independently provide the same attacker membership row.
probes.query: SELECT RequirementSetId, RequirementId FROM RequirementSetRequirements WHERE RequirementSetId = 'ATTACKING_REQUIREMENT_SET' AND RequirementId = 'PLAYER_IS_ATTACKER_REQUIREMENTS' ORDER BY RequirementSetId, RequirementId

probes.rationale: Macedon/Persia and Vikings independently provide the same all-of attacker requirement set.
probes.query: SELECT RequirementSetId, RequirementSetType FROM RequirementSets WHERE RequirementSetId = 'ATTACKING_REQUIREMENT_SET' ORDER BY RequirementSetId

probes.rationale: Removing the later duplicate must not remove the earlier Work Ethic Temple production binding.
probes.query: SELECT BeliefType, ModifierID FROM BeliefModifiers WHERE BeliefType = 'BELIEF_WORK_ETHIC' AND ModifierID = 'WORK_ETHIC_TEMPLE_PRODUCTION' ORDER BY BeliefType, ModifierID

probes.rationale: Removing the later duplicate must not remove the earlier Work Ethic Shrine production binding.
probes.query: SELECT BeliefType, ModifierID FROM BeliefModifiers WHERE BeliefType = 'BELIEF_WORK_ETHIC' AND ModifierID = 'WORK_ETHIC_SHRINE_PRODUCTION' ORDER BY BeliefType, ModifierID

probes.rationale: Removing the later BBM duplicate must leave Spain's earlier tier-one Coast bias intact.
probes.query: SELECT CivilizationType, TerrainType, Tier FROM StartBiasTerrains WHERE CivilizationType = 'CIVILIZATION_SPAIN' AND TerrainType = 'TERRAIN_COAST' ORDER BY CivilizationType, TerrainType

probes.rationale: Removing the later Maya/Colombia duplicate must leave the base Nihang bypass-walls type.
probes.query: SELECT Type, Kind FROM Types WHERE Type = 'ABILITY_BYPASS_WALLS_PROMOTION_CLASS' ORDER BY Type

probes.rationale: Removing the later Maya/Colombia duplicate must leave the base Nihang wall-attack type.
probes.query: SELECT Type, Kind FROM Types WHERE Type = 'ABILITY_ENABLE_WALL_ATTACK_PROMOTION_CLASS' ORDER BY Type

probes.rationale: Removing the later Maya/Colombia duplicate must leave the complete base Nihang bypass-walls ability.
probes.query: SELECT UnitAbilityType, Name, Description, Permanent FROM UnitAbilities WHERE UnitAbilityType = 'ABILITY_BYPASS_WALLS_PROMOTION_CLASS' ORDER BY UnitAbilityType

probes.rationale: Removing the later Maya/Colombia duplicate must leave the complete base Nihang wall-attack ability.
probes.query: SELECT UnitAbilityType, Name, Description, Permanent FROM UnitAbilities WHERE UnitAbilityType = 'ABILITY_ENABLE_WALL_ATTACK_PROMOTION_CLASS' ORDER BY UnitAbilityType

probes.rationale: The live database must keep Gaul's Mine Culture modifier at Bronze Working and scope it to Mine plots.
probes.query: SELECT ModifierId, ModifierType, OwnerRequirementSetId, SubjectRequirementSetId FROM Modifiers WHERE ModifierId = 'GAUL_MINE_CULTURE' ORDER BY ModifierId

probes.rationale: The live database must resolve Gaul's Mine bonus to exactly +1 Culture.
probes.query: SELECT ModifierId, Name, Value FROM ModifierArguments WHERE ModifierId = 'GAUL_MINE_CULTURE' AND Name IN ('Amount', 'YieldType') ORDER BY ModifierId, Name

probes.rationale: Vercingetorix must not retain a second copy of the Gaul civilization Mine Culture bonus.
probes.query: SELECT TraitType, ModifierId FROM TraitModifiers WHERE TraitType = 'TRAIT_LEADER_SUK_GALLIC_WAR' AND ModifierId = 'GAUL_MINE_CULTURE' ORDER BY TraitType, ModifierId

probes.rationale: Gran Colombia must use the original no-prerequisite all-unit ability grant modifier.
probes.query: SELECT ModifierId, ModifierType, OwnerRequirementSetId, SubjectRequirementSetId FROM Modifiers WHERE ModifierId = 'TRAIT_EJERCITO_PATRIOTA_EXTRA_MOVEMENT' ORDER BY ModifierId

probes.rationale: The restored Gran Colombia movement modifier must grant the original movement ability.
probes.query: SELECT ModifierId, Name, Value FROM ModifierArguments WHERE ModifierId = 'TRAIT_EJERCITO_PATRIOTA_EXTRA_MOVEMENT' AND Name = 'AbilityType' ORDER BY ModifierId, Name

probes.rationale: The civic-gated BBG Gran Colombia movement modifier must not remain attached alongside the restored rule.
probes.query: SELECT TraitType, ModifierId FROM TraitModifiers WHERE TraitType = 'TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_EJERCITO_PATRIOTA' AND ModifierId = 'BBG_COLUMBIA_MOVEMENT_BONUS' ORDER BY TraitType, ModifierId

probes.rationale: Jayavarman's old leader-only river Faith attachment must be absent after moving the rule to the Khmer civilization.
probes.query: SELECT TraitType, ModifierId FROM TraitModifiers WHERE TraitType = 'TRAIT_LEADER_MONASTERIES_KING' AND ModifierId = 'TRAIT_MONASTERIES_KING_HOLY_SITE_RIVER_ADJACENCY' ORDER BY TraitType, ModifierId

probes.rationale: The constant SELECT-to-VALUES cleanup must preserve the Fire Goddess geothermal feature argument exactly.
probes.query: SELECT RequirementId, Name, Value, Type, Extra, SecondExtra FROM RequirementArguments WHERE RequirementId = 'BBG_TILE_IS_FISSURE_FEATURE_GEOTHERMAL_FISSURE' AND Name = 'FeatureType' ORDER BY RequirementId, Name
